column1: Improper validation of code-specified array index
column2: Using a code-specified value as an index to an array, without proper validation, can lead to index out of bound exceptions.
column4: [["Random value"|"relative:///com/sallm/Tainted/CodeQL/p_85_f_130/codeql_cwe338_0_130_Finnish.java:26:30:26:60"]] flows to the index used in this array access, and may cause the operation to throw an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
